questions.question: Which animal is often called the 'King of the Jungle'?
questions.hint: The lion is commonly known as the 'King of the Jungle' because of its strength, leadership, and majestic appearance.

questions.question: What do bees produce?
questions.hint: Bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey.

questions.question: Which company created Mickey Mouse?
questions.hint: Mickey Mouse was introduced by Walt Disney.

questions.question: What is the name of the school attended by Harry Potter?
questions.hint: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry is the magical school in Harry Potter.

questions.question: Which traffic light color means 'Stop'?
questions.hint: Red traffic lights are used worldwide to signal drivers and pedestrians to stop.

questions.question: Which document is commonly required for international travel?
questions.hint: A passport verifies your identity and nationality when traveling between countries.

questions.question: Which ancient civilization built the famous pyramids?
questions.hint: The Great Pyramids of Giza were built by ancient Egyptians.

questions.question: Who was the first President of the United States?
questions.hint: George Washington served as the first President of the United States.

questions.question: How many players from one team are on the field during a soccer match?
questions.hint: Each soccer team has 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question: Which sport is played using a racket?
questions.hint: Players use rackets to hit a ball across the net in tennis.

questions.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.hint: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all other oceans.

questions.question: On which continent is Egypt located?
questions.hint: Most of Egypt lies in northeastern Africa.

questions.question: At what temperature does water freeze?
questions.hint: Pure water freezes and turns into ice at 0°C.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.hint: Mercury is the nearest planet to the Sun.

questions.question: Which country is most famous for sushi?
questions.hint: Sushi originated in Japan and is now enjoyed worldwide.

questions.question: Flamenco is a traditional dance from which country?
questions.hint: Flamenco originated in southern Spain.

questions.question: Which bird cannot fly?
questions.hint: Penguins use their wings for swimming rather than flying.

questions.question: What is the capital city of France?
questions.hint: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.

questions.question: Which gas do humans need to breathe to survive?
questions.hint: Humans use oxygen during respiration to release energy from food.

questions.question: Wimbledon is a famous tournament in which sport?
questions.hint: Wimbledon is one of the oldest and most prestigious tennis tournaments.
